thread:
A Heroku Alternative for Modern Apps

Quick thread 🧵
Heroku pioneered git-push deploys and the dyno, and that was genuinely great.
The dated part is the economics: dynos are metered (the Eco tier sleeps after 30 minutes idle), every add-on is a separate bill, and free plans ended November 28, 2022.
A modern Heroku alternative keeps the push-to-deploy flow but runs your whole app (web, worker, cron, database) on one owned server at a flat price.
Every Heroku concept maps cleanly onto it.
